title: After the Mainichi Okan - To Set Our Sights On What Lies Ahead

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka was truly amazing huh…! 
It's a completely different dimension 
compared to the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Such an amazing run, oh it was so 
exciting～…! For there to be a girl 
to run with such precise form…!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
For the very first time, I'm almost there… 
So in the next race… Surely…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Huff…… Huff…… Huff……——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Suzuka, you ——

"——It's the 3rd corner! It's Silence 
Suzuka about to take off for the skies!!!——"
"She's made it past the great elm!!!——"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …Jee, you're already there aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ……Stego?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Your next race…… is it the Autumn 
Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh? …Yes. That is my current plan but ——

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Why do you ask……?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Nothing much really. I was just a 
little curious, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Your running today was amazing. I'm 
looking forward to the Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you very much……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, see ya later ——

Stay Gold returned with no trouble after 
running in the Mainichi Okan. Though, 
somehow her face reflected a solemn 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……So it seems, the time has finally arrived. 
The true "storm" for this journey to reach.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's run today, how would 
you describe it?

Her run today brought about an absolutely 
overwhelming aura. I never expected that a 
horsegirl in the Classics could ever grow to 
this stage so tremendously quickly.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, she's too fast.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
With that said, her strength has delivered 
her straight up to the twinkling aurora 
in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
For "The Ones Who Shine", it's the twinkles 
they leave behind that are etched into my 
"memories", that moment where they 
become their most dazzling selves ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Well, think of it as the moment 
a seed bursts into flower.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, her moment is not 
supposed to happen yet, not in the 
Classics… According to my "memories" 
that is.
choice_data_list: But for her to have reached it already…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah… At this rate, if she reaches the 
aurora at the same pace as she does 
in my "memories"………

…… Within less than a fraction of a 
second, I felt a stillness that could 
stop time seep through the air.

Which is precisely why it was such a dreadful 
lingering moment. The petite figure in front 
of me remained reticent, yet it was clear that 
there were intense emotions swirling within —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Trainer. I have a favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Let me run in the Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I won't run in that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……In Suzuka's next race, by competing 
against her, there is something I must 
confirm.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That, from the beginning of our journey to 
destroy my past until now, something 
would potentially happen.

Stay Gold's pupils are directed somewhere 
further. They're looking straight towards 
where our next destination should be with 
an unwavering resolve. Well then ——
choice_data_list: I got it, leave it to me
I got it, leave it to me

text_block_list.text:
…All the work towards the Kikuka Sho will 
all be redirected towards the Autumn Tenno 
Sho. Furthermore, we need to prepare for 
the showdown with Silence Suzuka.

From an outsider's point of view, this 
change of plans seems completely absurd. 
However, this was always an unpredictable 
journey, which is why ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Just as expected.

……Just like that, our key route towards 
the Kikuka Sho has now been rerouted to 
the Autumn Tenno Sho.

Shall we be witnessing the jet black storm 
clouds blocking our route? Or will it be the 
aurora, shredding through the darkness 
which blocks our path?
